notes.title: 🎉 Early Access Release Date Announcement 🎉
notes.notes:
[b]Hey settlers,👋[/b]

Straight to the big news:
[u][h3]🥳 The Steam Early Access Release of our game will happen on the 2nd of April 2024! 🥳[/h3][/u]

[previewyoutube=md-g0UNTBV4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Calling All Settlers: Help Shape Circle of Kerzoven's Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hey settlers, 👋

It's October and we have some [b]exciting news[/b] for you!

[h2]👀 New CLOSED Playtest Sessions[/h2]

We're nearing the final months of Circle of Kerzoven's development for Early Access and [b]we need YOU[/b] to make Kerzoven even better. To ensure top quality, we're starting focused playtests with a [b]limited number of players today![/b]

[b][h3]This way you can help us with the development:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Sign up for the closed playtest at this link: [url=https://forms.gle/jMuNXxJSDpUXy3Gz8 ]https://forms.gle/jMuNXxJSDpUXy3Gz8 [/url]
[*] Wait until you have been accepted for the playtest.
[*] Play the latest playtest version of Circle of Kerzoven.

[*] BONUS POINTS: Record your play session and send us the video privately.
[/list]
For those of you who don't make it to the first playtest round. Don't worry, we will invite new players for each round. Until then, feel free to play our [b]public demo:[/b] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733110/Circle_of_Kerzoven/?utm_source=playtestnews

[h2]😻 We reached our community goals![/h2]

We are happy to announce that the [b]two new animals[/b], cat and cow, will also be included in the game at Early Access!

[url=https://linktr.ee/kerzoven][img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/529/350/033e69d051ec9bef5567d7405d8adae8_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1696277328&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=3f873510a35e367c1be80666c4dde0bf[/img][/url]

Thanks to you ❤️ we reached the Kickstarter Community Goals this summer! We are now 1100 settlers on this Discord and have collected over 25k wishlists!

That's it from us for now, back to work. [b]Thank you[/b] for making Circle of Kerzoven possible.

[b]Your Team Kerzoven 🥰[/b]

notes.title: Mountain Map
notes.notes:
How are you, settlers? 👋 

There's a lot to report today! 
From the ongoing Earth Appreciation Festival to our new map Herznach and the new key art. Here we go.

[u][b]WELCOME TO HERZNACH🏔️ [/b][/u]
After the desert map Zimmen, there is now another region in the game with harsh survival conditions. We are curious to see how you manage to maintain your settlement in rocky Herznach. Feel free to post a screenshot of your village in our [b][url=https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG]Discord[/url][/b]. 

[url=https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146497/8d2811ca4dee4ed3031c5277c852713214c2b365.gif[/img][/url]

[u][b]LEVEL SYSTEM REWORK🔧 [/b][/u]
The level system has been increased from 5 levels to 7. It has also been incorporated into the region progression and building system. We are very interested in feedback on the gameplay of this rework and would be super grateful for a few words about it in our [url=https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG][b]Discord[/b][/url].

[u][b]How do you join the Alpha Playtest❓[/b][/u]
Quite simply, you join our Discord here: [url=https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG]https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG[/url]

[u][b]NEW KEY ART🦊 [/b][/u]
We are really proud to show you our new key art that a fellow Swiss game designer has been working on for the last few weeks. We hope you like Jim's new look.

[url=https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146497/4bc45873f8f08770610297e4cb0d379c55785e1b.png[/img][/url]

[u][b]EARTH APPRECIATION FESTIVAL🌍 [/b][/u]
On April 22nd we celebrate Earth Day on Steam. There we are part of the Earth Appreciation Festival. It's super cool to see our game next to games like Timberborn or Going Medieval. You can find the sale here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/appreciateearth2023]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/appreciateearth2023[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146497/0fdceac1d6bb95ef9186d3802ac090af951c6732.png[/img]

You see there is a lot going on in Kerzoven! Thanks for joining us on our journey and see you soon.
[b]The Kerzoven Team[/b]🥰

notes.title: UI PLAYTEST
notes.notes:
[b]How's it going, Settlers? 👋[/b]
First of all, welcome to all those who have moved into our settlement. Welcome to Kerzoven! The last public demo at the Base Building Festival was very well received by you and a huge article was published in the GameStar magazine: [url=https://bit.ly/41xSOiG]https://bit.ly/41xSOiG[/url] (in German)

[u][b]BIG UI OVERHAUL: [/b][/u]
Marco, Denise, Pierre and Manuel have spent the last month reworking the user interface of Circle of Kerzoven from the ground up. The goal: A more pleasant game flow and a better general overview.
You can now play the first preview of this work in the latest version of the playtest.

As always, We have summarized what the focus of this demo is in our [url=https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG][b]Discord[/b][/url] in the #faq  channel. Feedback is still available in #alpha-feedback  and if you want to post a video of your playthrough you can do so in #your-videos.

[u][b]How do you join the Alpha Playtest?[/b][/u]
Quite simply, you join our Discord here: [url=https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG]https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG[/url]

Then click on the link for the role "🎮Alpha Playtester" in the
channel "⭐︱get-your-role-here" and fill out the form.

After a few minutes you will receive a playtest key by mail.
You can activate this key on Steam and then download the «Circle of Kerzoven»
playtest and start building.

As always: A big thanks to you, without you the community Circle of Kerzoven would not be possible!
[b]The Kerzoven Team[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41146497/fe625996f19ca031ca1bf268d31966e5e6942f95.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: DIRT DEMO – BASE BUILDER FEST
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Settlers, 👋 [/b]
Maybe you have already noticed, something is happening in Kerzoven. 
We are participating in [b]the Steam Base Builder Fest![/b] 
But before we get to that, thanks to the whole community for playing the Discord Alpha Test 
in early December! We were able to gather a massive amount of valuable feedback and improve the current build immensely. 

[u][b]THE DIRT DEMO 💩 [/b][/u]
[b]Tomorrow Monday at 7pm (CET)[/b] the Base Builder Fest starts on 
Steam and with it a [b]brand new publicly available demo! [/b]
We all know that life as a settler is a filthy business. 
So currently everything also revolves around the cleanliness of your villagers, 
who now have to deal with a neat dirt simulation. 
You can also expect an improved water simulation and weirs. 
On top of that, there is a little surprise when you start Kerzoven.

As always, We have summarized what the focus of this demo is in our [url=https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG][b]Discord[/b][/url] in the #faq  channel. Feedback is still available in #alpha-feedback  and if you want to post a video of your playthrough you can do so in #your-videos.

Thank you all and hello to all newcomers, welcome!
[b]Your Kerzoven Team[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1733110/extras/B_D_DitP.gif?t=1674223160[/img][/url]

notes.title: First freely available Alpha Playtest
notes.notes:
Welcome to the first freely available playtest of Circle of Kerzoven. 

[h3]❓What is waiting to be tested?[/h3]
1. How does the new fence & road building system feel?
2. Does the new save / load mechanic work as intended?
3. Are the new animations with the items good (transporting goods, build things...)?

Our next target is to improve the UI. If you have ideas, feel something is missing or 
already good please let us know.

[h3]🎮 How do you join the Alpha Playtest?[/h3]
Quite simply, you join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/2QfAy5W6CG

Quite simply, you join our Discord here: 
Then click on the link for the role "🎮Alpha Playtester" in the 
channel "⭐︱get-your-role-here" and fill out the form.

After a few minutes you will receive a playtest key by mail. 
You can activate this key on Steam and then download the «Circle of Kerzoven» 
playtest and start building.
